title: The overconvergence of multivariable $(\varphi_q,\mathcal{O}_K^{\times})$-modules at the perfectoid level
summary: Let $K$ be a finite unramified extension of $\mathbb{Q}_p$, and $E$ a finite extension of $K$ with ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_E$. We define the overconvergence of multivariable $(\varphi_q,\mathcal{O}_K^{\times})$-modules over $A_{\mathrm{mv},E}$ and explore some basic properties. We prove the overconvergence at the perfectoid level using the geometry of relative Fargues-Fontaine curve.
